name: Money Parasite ~Usotsuki na Onna~
source:
I've had a dream since I was little.

I've dreamt of the magic that left an impression on me and, shy as I was, let me make my first friend. Before I noticed, I couldn't stop thinking about magic and wanting to become a magician.

However now that I'm a college student, my life consists of working different part-time jobs, coming back home and sleeping.
The only thing I enjoy doing in my free time is watching gaming videos.

I gave up on my dream coming true... My beloved magic tools are gathering dust now.

But then, I received an invitation for a magic show held on a luxurious cruise ship.
I wasn't invited as a guest, but as a performer.
If I do well, I could potentially become a pro magician.
I was happy. I started dreaming again. I couldn't stop thinking about the possibilities.

But waiting for me were men of unbelievable status and a strange fox plushie. That plushie then said:

"Use those skills of yours to snatch some money off them. I want to see some fun drama!"

[translated from [url=http://www.takuyo.co.jp/products/money/story/story.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
从小，我就有一个梦想。

曾让我深受触动的魔术，帮助害羞的我交到了第一个朋友。不知不觉间，我满脑子都只想着魔术，想要成为一名魔术师。

然而，如今已经是大学生的我，每天都在不同的兼职之间奔波，回家，然后睡觉。
闲暇时，唯一的乐趣就是看游戏视频。

我已经放弃实现梦想……心爱的魔术道具，如今也积满了灰尘。

可就在这时，我收到了一封邀请函，邀请我参加豪华邮轮上的魔术表演。
身份并非观众，而是演出者。
如果表现出色，也许就能成为职业魔术师。
我很高兴，又重新做起了梦，满心想着未来的种种可能。

然而，等待我的，却是地位高得难以置信的男人们，以及一只奇怪的狐狸玩偶。然后，那只玩偶开口说道。

“用你的本事，从他们身上捞点钱吧。我想看些有趣的戏码！”

[译自[url=http://www.takuyo.co.jp/products/money/story/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
